prayerTimes.title: Prayer times
prayerTimes.subtitle: View the five daily prayer times for your location.
prayerTimes.promptLocation: To display prayer times, we need to know your location.
prayerTimes.errorRetry: Please check your internet connection and try again.
prayerTimes.footerNote: Prayer times are calculated from your location and the selected method. Times may vary slightly from your local mosque. Where possible, follow your local mosque's schedule.

qibla.title: Qibla direction
qibla.subtitle: Find the direction of the Qibla, the Kaaba in Makkah, from your location.
qibla.promptLocation: To find the Qibla direction, we need to know your location.
qibla.directionStatement: The Qibla from your location is {bearing}° from North.
qibla.aboutBody: The Qibla is the direction Muslims face during prayer, pointing toward the Kaaba in the Sacred Mosque (Al-Masjid al-Haram) in Makkah. For best accuracy, use a physical compass to align with the bearing shown above.

masjidFinder.title: Find a mosque near you
masjidFinder.subtitle: Locate mosques in your area for congregational prayers and community.
masjidFinder.promptLocation: Set your location to find mosques nearby.
masjidFinder.googleSearchBody: Find mosques with reviews, directions, and prayer times.
masjidFinder.osmSearchBody: Free, community-driven map of mosques worldwide.
masjidFinder.tipsHeading: Tips for finding your local mosque
masjidFinder.tip1: Search for "mosque", "masjid", or "Islamic center" in your area.
masjidFinder.tip2: Many mosques welcome new Muslims and have programmes for reverts.
masjidFinder.tip3: Don't be shy to visit during prayer times. The community will be happy to help.
masjidFinder.tip4: Friday (Jumu'ah) prayer is a great first visit. Arrive early to meet people.
